jobs.title: Frontend Developer Intern (React) - remote ok
jobs.remoteReason: Fully remote, async-friendly. Standup at 9am ET.
jobs.description: Join our small frontend team rebuilding the customer dashboard in React + TypeScript. You will ship real features in your first week, pair with senior engineers, and learn how a production React app is structured (routing, state, data fetching, testing). We use Next.js, Tailwind, and Vite. 3-month internship, stipend available.

evaluation.summary: Strong match on core React/TypeScript skills. Need to demonstrate CSS fundamentals and Git workflow before applying.

jobs.title: Backend intern needed ASAP - FastAPI + Postgres
jobs.remoteReason: Office-first but 'maybe remote' — manager said flexible for the right candidate. Not confirmed in writing.
jobs.description: We are building an internal audit tool for logistics clients. Backend is Python + FastAPI + PostgreSQL. Intern will write endpoints, fix bugs, and sit in on code review. Good opportunity if you want to see how real backend services are deployed. 2 months, extendable.

evaluation.summary: You have Python but no demonstrated FastAPI, PostgreSQL, or Docker. The unclear remote situation adds risk — ask for written confirmation before investing time.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern (NLP focus)
jobs.remoteReason: On-site in Nairobi; visa support for exceptional candidates only.
jobs.description: Work on Amharic and Swahili NLP datasets — tokenization, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You will train and evaluate transformer models, build data pipelines, and read papers with the research team. 6-month internship with a path to full-time.

evaluation.summary: Missing PyTorch — the core requirement. On-site Nairobi makes this a non-starter for an Ethiopia-based applicant unless relocation is on the table.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (mid-level)
jobs.description: We are hiring a mid-level full stack developer to own features end-to-end: React frontend, Node.js services, Postgres. You will work with a team of 8 across 4 time zones. Must have 2+ years of professional experience shipping production web apps.

evaluation.summary: Frontend stack is a great match, but this role expects backend ownership (Node, Postgres) and 2 years of experience. Possible stretch if you can demonstrate backend projects.

jobs.title: Data Science Intern — analyze delivery metrics
jobs.remoteReason: Fully remote; code reviews on GitHub, async standups.
jobs.description: We need someone to dig into our delivery telemetry: clean CSVs, build dashboards, and present findings to the ops team. Python + pandas preferred. The internship is 3 months, part-time friendly.

evaluation.summary: Python is there but no pandas/SQL/Statistics. You could take this if you are willing to learn pandas quickly — the bar is low and the domain is interesting.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer (AWS + K8s)
jobs.description: Own our Kubernetes clusters on AWS: deployments, observability, incident response. Requirements: production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and at least one major cloud. 3+ years of experience required.

evaluation.summary: This role requires production DevOps experience you do not have yet. Revisit in 1–2 years after picking up Docker and AWS fundamentals.

jobs.title: Mobile dev intern (React Native) — 20 hrs/week
jobs.remoteReason: Mostly remote but wants someone in Addis for occasional whiteboard sessions.
jobs.description: Help us build a React Native app for field health workers: offline sync, photo capture, and maps. You will work with one senior mobile dev. The role is part-time (20 hrs/week) so it fits alongside studies.

evaluation.summary: React Native is a small leap from React and the part-time structure is attractive. Confirm the hybrid expectation in Addis before applying.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern, Platform Team
jobs.remoteReason: Fully remote, flexible hours across time zones.
jobs.description: 12-week paid internship on the platform team: TypeScript services, PostgreSQL, and a React admin console. You will own a small project end-to-end with a dedicated mentor and present it to the engineering org at the end.

evaluation.summary: Best match so far. TypeScript + React are core requirements and the mentorship structure is excellent. Brush up on Git workflows and testing basics before the interview.

jobs.title: AI Research Scholarship — LLMs for Low-Resource Languages
jobs.remoteReason: Remote-friendly; monthly in-person meetups in Addis.
jobs.description: 12-month research scholarship for students working on LLMs for Ethiopian languages. Includes a monthly stipend, compute credits, and mentorship from our research team. You will publish at least one workshop paper. Open to final-year undergrads and master's students.

evaluation.summary: Strong foundation with Python + Hugging Face. The gap is PyTorch and formal research experience — a personal fine-tuning project would close this fast.

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Intern
jobs.remoteReason: On-site in Accra with relocation package.
jobs.description: Support our cloud team: provision infrastructure with Terraform, monitor AWS services, and learn incident response. Great first industry role if you want to break into DevOps. 6-month internship, possible conversion.

evaluation.summary: Almost no overlap with your current skills. This is a DevOps role — your Python helps with automation but AWS/K8s/Docker are hard requirements.

jobs.title: Security Engineering Intern (app security)
jobs.description: Join our security team: code reviews with a security lens, help run our bug bounty triage, and write tooling. You will learn OWASP, threat modeling, and how real security teams operate. 4-month internship, stipend included.

evaluation.summary: Security is a new domain for you. Python helps, but you would need to learn networking and security basics. Long-term interesting — short-term stretch.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (early-stage startup)
jobs.remoteReason: Remote-first culture, but the team meets quarterly in Nairobi. Open to discussing relocation support.
jobs.description: We are a 5-person startup building invoicing software for African SMEs. As the first product engineer you will wear many hats: React frontend, some Node backend, talking to customers, and shaping the product. 2+ years of experience required.

evaluation.summary: Good frontend match, but the role expects backend chops and customer-facing communication. The startup environment could be a fast learning opportunity if you are ready for the ambiguity.
